criteria: Review the owned autocomplete trigger NgZone dependency, full constructor service identity, blur registration/callback/removal and two explicit view reentry boundaries.

reviews.decision: The stable public NgZone import supplies the required fourth parameter of the owned eleven-argument historical autocomplete trigger. Every original parameter declaration is unchanged. Checker binding accounts for exactly one type reference, one runOutsideAngular listener registration, two run calls and one identical service forwarding to afterLegacyRender with the supplied view injector; no other service escape exists. The complete emitted constructor matches untouched16 outside five specifically enumerated existing current initializers (handset subscription, initialization stream, blur/focus callback, deferred option-selection stream and borrowed view lookup), with two corresponding original callback/stream initializers recorded separately. Their wider feature semantics are not granted blanket approval. Complete current/original class definitions and real constructors execute outside ambient DI with genuine public original/minimum NgZone, QueryList/EventEmitter and current public application providers. A genuine public injector and CDK BreakpointObserver token supply an explicit borrowed value; the child leaves it alive and only its actual injector owner destroys it. Window blur registration/removal preserve the exact handler; actual patched Node EventEmitter proves captured callback context, three historical focus/panel states, preservation of foreign listeners and no late state change. Both view-update/opened and closed-event callbacks reenter the real Angular zone; helper forwarding preserves actual zone/injector identity. Fifty supplementary cases and seventy-four applicable behavior faults pass across ten development/production subjects; no-op modes are not credited with distinguishing zone contexts. Sixteen source/declaration/evidence controls and three strict public-type subjects with twenty-four negative contracts pass. The old render report was stale for the complete option source and is explicitly excluded as a current-source pass. Its unchanged original producer was freshly run on both lines: ten render subjects and all sixteen existing faults pass with exact current trigger/helper/event-source and namespace hashes. The supplement uses explicit window/DOM/focus/overlay/panel/CDR/view-container and borrowed-service protocols; native shadow focus/events/geometry, actual legacy component node DI, real observer construction, full overlay lifetime, packed/AOT/consumer and full runtime/compiler/RxJS floors remain pending. This decision approves this public dependency boundary only.
